items.title: Ray Vega interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 20, 2023
items.q: You know Tom Brown who played the funky trumpet from Jamaica Queens back in the late 70s, early 80s. I like those records.

ctx.x: Yeah, you know I don’t have a problem. I’m not such a music — what’s the word — snob. Oh it’s got to be this. No. I see there’s purposes and — purposes for a lot of things. You know Tom Brown who played the funky trumpet from Jamaica Queens back in the late 70s, early 80s. I like those records. It’s all good. Because it has a purpose and there’s an audience for that.
You try to tell your students about — well I’ll rephrase — is there anything on the bandstand that will aggravate you?
